dxc /Tcs_6_0 /Emain shader.txt

The command line exactly as filed in the issue body.

cmd.txt differs in three cosmetic ways and in nothing else:

  1. `/T`/`/E` are written `-T`/`-E`. Same options; the `-` spelling is also the only one
     Compiler Explorer's Linux builds can parse, since a `/`-prefixed argument there looks
     like a path.
  2. The arguments are separated from their values (`/Tcs_6_0` -> `-T cs_6_0`), which dxc
     accepts identically.
  3. The input is named `repro.hlsl` rather than `shader.txt`. It is a byte-for-byte copy of
     the issue's attachment (SHA-256 2A47875 53E150F6B119C40AF0026ED50B6B0350F15904651CFBE0B7D5E614CDF);
     `attachment-shader.txt` in this directory is the original, and
     `variant-as-filed-txt-main-debug.txt` captures the same command run against it, to show
     the extension changes nothing.

No workaround flags were filed, so there is none to remove.

Note also that damyanp's 2024-07-16 comment links a Compiler Explorer session built with
`-T cs_6_6` and no `-E`. That is not the configuration in the body; it is captured separately
as `variant-cs66-main-debug.txt` rather than substituted into cmd.txt.
